description: This Java source file defines a utility class ApplicationContextListenerUtils that implements an application listener for ContextStartedEvent events. It retrieves a SearchService bean from the Spring application context and initializes it when the application context starts.

classes.name: ApplicationContextListenerUtils
classes.description: A utility class that listens for the application context start event and initializes the SearchService bean.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles the ContextStartedEvent by retrieving and initializing the SearchService bean.
